arguments.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this adult cartoon mermaid sprite. Image 1 is the existing drawing to preserve. Image 2 is its exact original pose reference, whose red/white stippling is diagnostic skin coloring. Change only the visible eye and brow to a playful, cheerful expression: relaxed brow, a warm bright eye and lifted cheek. Keep the mouth hidden below the waterline as in the current drawing. Do not reveal more face or body to add a smile. Preserve her established adult identity, golden-blonde hair, turquoise band, tan skin, opaque green swimsuit top and green mermaid tail wherever visible. Her mood should read as happy and playful, never worried, sad or stoic. Keep the cel-shaded linework, source-facing direction, limb ownership, proportions, occlusion and thin cyan/white water strokes. Do not invent hidden anatomy or add scenery. Output one complete sprite with genuine transparent background and comfortable clear padding on all sides, no checkerboard, text or ground.
